purpose: 0251 spec section 5.3 / FRONTIER item (D): pinned zero-stream + cited-record checksums for the hPT2 / [Z-PT] / [Z-PT2] provenance layer. Bit-anchors the exact objects the in-tree citations refer to, so the citation chain [Z-PT] (Platt isolation) + [Z-PT2] (Platt-Trudgian Theorem 1) is verifiable against immutable artifacts. Provenance hardening only - does not gate the endpoint, adds no RH claim, no zeta content in the pinned objects beyond what the papers and stream already assert.

zero_stream.source: beta.lmfdb.org/riemann-zeta-zeros (raw zero files, platt_zeros.py 104-bit record convention per references.md)

honesty: No RH claim: these pins anchor the provenance of CITED records ([Z-PT], [Z-PT2], the LMFDB stream). The endpoint stays conditional; hOffCPT2 stays open (0261/0262).

The Platt 2017 pin is the AAM, not the AMS version of record - the version-of-record coordinates (86(307), 2449-2467, 10.1090/mcom/3198) are recorded beside it; the two differ in the journal's production typography, not in the theorem content claimed here.

The zero-stream pin covers the on-disk project slice (11 shards, ~682 MB), not the full 12,857-shard public stream; the full-stream claim of [Z-PT] rests on the Platt 2017 paper (pinned) plus the LMFDB database as public witness (URL recorded).
The project's own ingest-time md5 gates on the LMFDB shards (references.md) remain the per-run integrity check; this pin is the cross-run, cross-machine bit anchor.
